sdlc_phase_a.rationale: The driver's automatic classifier only checks primary-metric wins and ship-quality wins; it has no signal for 'a prior hard crash now completes.' Per autotrain-iteration-delivery.md category 3, this cycle is the required replay-proof: the identical frozen c2 manifests (source_commit a14c8767..., campaign continuous-loop-20260802-continuous-openui-202608-75a7803e-c2) hard-crashed both arms with an unrecoverable RuntimeError (AgentV SDK unavailable, then a NODE_OPTIONS rejection). After the c1/c2 infrastructure repairs (torch install; NODE_OPTIONS sanitization in commit ca15f5c, evals.agentv v6->v7), this cycle replays those exact frozen manifests and both arms complete end-to-end with real, honestly-computed scoreboards (expected_gate_rejection=true; the fixture n=3 ship-gate rejection is the correct, expected outcome for smoke-scale fixture data, not an infrastructure failure). No primary-metric win is claimed -- control and candidate are the same reused checkpoint (0.0 delta) -- only that the harness is unblocked.
sdlc_phase_a.stack_layer_ref: claude/great-dirac-ptxx92 (PR #1292), commits 561ecb6 (c1 torch doc), ca15f5c (AgentV NODE_OPTIONS fix), a9fcdf3 (c2 doc), and this cycle's doc

honesty: fixture/scratch measurement; ship gates correctly reject on evidence volume (n=3<20) and quality thresholds; no ship or production claim. This doc's positive claim is scoped strictly to 'the AgentV harness is unblocked and replay-proven,' not to any model quality result.
